title: RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences
abstract: arXiv:2611.32166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one mat

translated_title: RightDiff：学习依据正确差异进行评判的生成式奖励模型
translated_abstract: 生成式奖励模型通常依赖通用的查询级评分规则或不受约束的推理依据，忽视了成对偏好实际上是由响应特定的差异所驱动的这一事实。此外，仅以结果正确性为优化目标会促使模型利用冗长性和格式等表面捷径，从而引发推理依据漂移。为解决这些问题，我们提出RightDiff，它将成对评估结构化为一条以证据为基础的评估轨迹，并在单次自回归生成中执行。RightDiff显式地发现候选响应之间的对比差异，将其归类为实质性或非实质性因素，并在最终裁决前归纳出针对该响应对的评分规则。为了在训练这一过程时避免事后合理化，我们通过响应隔离提示合成演示数据，并利用差异对齐奖励对奖励模型进行优化，同时以预算约束的一对一匹配进行正则化……
tldr: RightDiff通过在单次自回归生成中显式发现候选响应间的对比差异、区分实质性与非实质性因素并归纳针对响应对的评分规则，学习以“正确差异”为核心的生成式奖励模型，从而避免表面捷径与推理依据漂移。
en_tdlr: RightDiff learns generative reward models that judge by the right differences—explicitly discovering contrastive differences between candidate responses, categorizing them as material or immaterial, and inducing pair-specific rubrics within a single autoregressive evaluation trajectory—thereby avoiding superficial shortcuts and rationale drift.
